# The Lantern Below

Mira delivers light through an underground city that has forgotten the color of morning. Her final parcel is a glass seed, warm as a held breath, meant for the failing garden beneath the central tower. At the dispatch hall, a tremor cracks the bridge ahead and scatters commuters into dark tunnels. Mira could wait for repairs, but the seed dims each minute.

She takes an abandoned maintenance route, following old brass arrows through a silent generator chamber. There she finds Ivo, a young mechanic trapped behind a fallen cable frame. Mira sets down the precious case and uses her courier strap to pull the frame aside. Together they climb the service ladder while the city lights blink out level by level.

At the garden door, the seed gives its last small pulse. Ivo reconnects a broken conduit as Mira plants the seed in dry soil. Roots of gold race beneath the floor, lamps awaken across the city, and projected dawn blooms on the vaulted ceiling. Mira watches strangers lift their faces toward the new light. Her empty delivery case feels lighter than anything she has carried.
